mapper.select: SELECT ClCd, ClName, PrdnClCd, Xpn, UseEan, ClDv, QeeSqo, UpdDate, Updpn, DirPath FROM pppo7010t where useean = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pppo7010t (ClCd, ClName, PrdnClCd, Xpn, UseEan, ClDv, QeeSqo, UpdDate, Updpn, DirPath) VALUES (#{ClCd}, #{ClName}, #{PrdnClCd}, #{Xpn}, #{UseEan}, #{ClDv}, #{QeeSqo}, #{UpdDate}, #{Updpn}, #{DirPath})
mapper.select: SELECT clcd, jijumcd, coid, ntnid, upddate, updpn FROM pppo7000t WHERE jijumcd = #{jijumcd} OR jijumcd = 'ALL'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pppo7000t (clcd, jijumcd, coid, ntnid, upddate, updpn) VALUES (#{clcd}, #{jijumcd}, #{coid}, #{ntnid}, #{upddate}, #{updpn})
